env_context_strategy.note: Codebase map/navigator injected plus agent exploration via built-in Explore agent (read-only codebase exploration).

observation_format.evidence_quote: leaving each one's exit code and output as evidence

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: It exposes 21 MoAI tools in six groups to Claude Code.

loop_primitives.note: plan_execute is the default SPEC pipeline; loop/fix gives generate_test_repair; hooks give event_driven; kanban/factory lanes give multi_attempt.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: GEARS-format requirements and acceptance criteria judge completion by evidence.
planning_granularity.note: SPEC documents under .moai/specs/ plus backlog cards via /moai todo.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: manager-lead | 🔴 | Hierarchical-team Tier L coordination + kanban/factory lead-session dispatch (sole Agent-carrier, depth-2 sealed)
multi_agent_topology.note: 12-agent catalog with lead dispatching subagents; hierarchical reachable via Tier L teams.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: that lane carries it through `plan → run → sync` serially in-session, each phase spawned as `Agent()` subagents

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: a turn limit (default 30), a stagnation guard, a wall-clock budget, and pre-approval gates
human_in_loop.note: Nothing is applied silently for harness rule promotion — approval comes first; cross-session messaging approval configurable in crosssession.yaml.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: WorktreeNode (13 fields) | Per-session state: ID, parent, depth, origin chain, milestone, resume target

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Progress stays in `progress.md`, handoff messages in memory, routing decisions in decision memory.
long_term_memory.note: skill_library = 11 ref + 7 domain skills loaded into agents.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: A 6-block paste-ready resume message carries progress into the next session; in auto-inject mode, one message resumes the session.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Seven read-only verifications (tests, coverage, subagent boundaries, sentinel scans, CLI smoke, benchmarks, lint) run in parallel in a single turn

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Declare a completion condition with `/moai goal` and the session works on its own until it holds.
retry_policy.note: Goal engine loops until condition holds, bounded by turn limit (default 30); auditor DEBT verdicts route back to prior phase.

rollback.note: worktree snapshot/restore plus `moai update` auto-rollback and `moai harness rollback`.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: a turn limit (default 30), a stagnation guard, a wall-clock budget, and pre-approval gates — so it cannot fall into an infinite loop
termination_condition.note: wall-clock budget is also a per-run timeout (F3); token circuit breaker aborts at hard limit (default 90%).

cost_controls.evidence_quote: a token circuit breaker stands guard — it aborts at the hard limit (default 90%), saves progress to `progress.md`
cost_controls.note: model_routing = 11 agents × 3 profiles of {model, effort}; caching = prompt-cache reuse.

timeouts.note: No per-tool timeout described in the evidence.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: A single Go binary with no extra dependencies, running on macOS, Linux, and Windows.
execution_isolation.note: Runs Claude Code on the host inside git worktrees; v3 design doc proposes sandboxing but README describes no default container.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Every SPEC gets its own working tree, a branch-state guard blocks accidental branch switches in the primary checkout
filesystem_access.note: Scoped to the card's worktree; relative to the host boundary of G1.

network_policy.note: No network restriction mechanism appears in the evidence; PR creation and remote sync require egress.

permission_model.note: Pre-tool/permission-request hooks gate actions mechanically; README: "The hook system enforces gates mechanically".

tracing.note: Plus `moai tokens record` ledger and decision memory; no OpenTelemetry in evidence.

replayability.evidence_quote: solves depth amnesia (root-to-leaf chain recovery after `/clear`), and detects dead leader sessions via heartbeat staleness
replayability.note: Session state/handoff can be resumed; no bit-for-bit replay claimed.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: `/moai gate` runs lint + format + type + tests in one pass, and sync-auditor scores across four dimensions
eval_hooks.note: Quality-gate/eval runners ship in-repo; no external benchmark harness (e.g. SWE-bench) in evidence.

guardrails.note: handle-user-prompt-submit.sh (input), handle-post-tool.sh / security-commit (output/action), handle-pre-tool.sh + permission-denied (action policies).
